title: Roster Layout & Unclaimed Account Filtering (v0.4.38)
message: Eliminated duplicate student accounts in Unclaimed Accounts, restructured roster cards to prevent badge squishing, and removed duplicate section headers.
changelog:
🔧 WHAT'S NEW IN v0.4.38:
• Unclaimed Accounts De-duplication: Active and claimed students are now completely excluded from Unclaimed Accounts.
• Responsive Roster Badges: Student gender and Phil-IRI badges now reside on a dedicated row with single-line enforcement, preventing vertical character wrapping.
• Clean Section Headers: Eliminated duplicate 'Active Students' stacked titles in class detail view.
